learnings.rule: Put the price (msrp) axis on a log scale with `scale_y_log10()`.
Color-encode country of origin with the ColorBrewer qualitative `Dark2` palette via `scale_color_brewer(type="qual", palette="Dark2")`.
Place the legend at the bottom with `legend_position="bottom"` in theme().
Make the scatter points translucent, `alpha=0.6` in geom_point.
Make the scatter points larger, `size=3` in geom_point.
